en.headline: Symphony of Lights paused from Wednesday until further notice
en.dek: The Tourism Commission said the nightly Victoria Harbour light-and-music show is suspended from 9 September, with no restart date given.
body: The Tourism Commission announced on Wednesday that A Symphony of Lights will be suspended from 9 September until further notice.

The brief government notice, issued for radio and television, did not state a reason or a date for the show to resume. The harbour-front display has run most evenings since 2004, linking buildings on both sides of Victoria Harbour with music and lighting.

Culture, Sports and Tourism Secretary Rosanna Law said earlier this year that the government planned a proper farewell for the show in the fourth quarter of 2026, to be replaced by more flexible light-and-projection programmes. The Tourism Commission did not say on Wednesday whether the pause is that farewell or a temporary halt.

zh.headline: 幻彩詠香江即日起暫停直至另行通知
zh.dek: 旅遊事務署公布，維港兩岸燈光音樂匯演由9月9日起暫停，未交代恢復日期。
body: 旅遊事務署周三宣布，「幻彩詠香江」由即日（9月9日）起暫停，直至另行通知。
政府發出的電台電視快訊未說明原因，亦無公布重開日期。這項維港兩岸大廈燈光音樂匯演自2004年起大部分晚上演出。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩今年較早時表示，計劃於2026年第四季為「幻彩詠香江」妥善告別，改以較具彈性的光影巡禮取代。旅遊事務署周三未有說明今次暫停是否告別安排，抑或屬暫時停辦。
